design_philosophy: Dark, minimal, aggressive aesthetic. No border radius anywhere. No gradients. No shadows. A raw, structural, grid-focused design inspired by high-end streetwear.

rules.headings: MUST use Impact font, uppercase only. Tight tracking (tracking-tight or tracking-tighter).
rules.body: MUST use Arial font. Clean, readable, geometric.

scales.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-7xl uppercase tracking-tighter leading-none

rules.surface_usage: Cards, dropdowns, and elevated containers use #111111.
rules.border_usage: Always 1px solid #1E1E1E. Used aggressively to define structure.
rules.text_usage: Primary text and icons use #C4C4C4. High emphasis text uses #FFFFFF.
rules.cta_usage: Primary buttons MUST have background #FFFFFF and text #0A0A0A. Hover state darkens slightly or inverts.

global_rules: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.

buttons.primary: bg-[#FFFFFF] text-[#0A0A0A] font-['Impact'] uppercase px-6 py-4 hover:bg-[#C4C4C4] transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#1E1E1E] text-[#FFFFFF] font-['Impact'] uppercase px-6 py-4 hover:bg-[#111111] transition-colors

components.inputs: bg-[#111111] border border-[#1E1E1E] text-[#C4C4C4] p-4 font-['Arial'] focus:outline-none focus:border-[#FFFFFF]
components.navigation: Sticky top, bg-[#0A0A0A], border-b border-[#1E1E1E]. Layout: Centered logo, left links, right icons.
components.announcement_bar: bg-[#111111] text-[#FFFFFF] font-['Impact'] uppercase text-sm py-2 border-b border-[#1E1E1E]. Fast marquee scroll. Content: 'BOLD. ELECTRIC. FEARLESS. / DROP 001 / NOT FOR EVERYONE.'
components.product_card: Bordered container. Image area border-b. Minimal text area: Brand, Title, Price.

layouts.grid_system: Visible borders on grid items (border-collapse style). Brutalist exposed structure.

homepage.hero: Massive typography, full width or structured grid layout. Stark imagery.
homepage.product_grid: 4 columns desktop, 2 mobile. gap-px bg-[#1E1E1E] (1px borders everywhere).
homepage.drop_stories: Horizontal scrolling list of circular or square portraits with visible borders.
homepage.editorial: Large asymmetric blocks of text and image.

product_page.layout: 2-column split desktop. Left: Sticky image gallery. Right: Scrolling product info.
product_page.actions: Massive, dominant ADD TO CART button.

layouts.cart_drawer: Slide from right. bg-[#0A0A0A] border-l border-[#1E1E1E]. Clear subtotal, free shipping message (> ₹999), checkout CTA.

media.rules: Never use placeholder images. Images should feel dark, raw, and high-end.

motion.philosophy: Instant and structural. Avoid bouncy or soft animations.
motion.hover_states: Hard cuts or fast fades on background colors. No scaling (no transform scaling).
motion.scrolling: Use smooth scrolling for marquee and horizontal scroll sections.

icons.style: Sharp, minimal, 1.5px stroke width. Consistent size (e.g., 20px or 24px).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure pure #FFFFFF text over #0A0A0A background for high-contrast readability.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly use tailwind classes font-['Impact'] and font-['Arial'].
Apply bg-[#0A0A0A] and text-[#C4C4C4] to the root body.
Completely ban rounded classes (e.g., rounded-md, rounded-lg, rounded-full) except for explicitly requested circular elements if any, otherwise stick to sharp corners.
Implement the 'Announcement Bar' at the very top using a marquee effect.
Create a solid grid structure with 1px solid #1E1E1E borders defining all sections.
Ensure the Cart is a slide-out drawer from the right side, with clear cart functionalities.
Build the product detail page with sticky images on the left and scrollable product info on the right.
Include 'BOLD. ELECTRIC. FEARLESS. / DROP 001 / NOT FOR EVERYONE.' heavily in the typography styling.
Ensure every interactive element (buttons, links, inputs) has a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.
